reason: A is more internally coherent and testable: it specifies substitutional Ti, requires retention of the BCC phase, measures room-temperature ductility, 1600 °C strength, and irradiation-induced defects against a composition series. Both proposals lack direct evidence that Ti enhances grain-boundary cohesion or preserves irradiation resistance, but B additionally invokes speculative coherent precipitates as “slip enhancers” and inaccurately treats Ti’s refractory character as sufficient protection of high-temperature and irradiation performance.
